title: The City of the Sun
author: Tommaso Campanella
description: "The City of the Sun" by Tommaso Campanella is a philosophical work written in 1602.
longDescription: Presented as a dialogue between a Knight Hospitaller and a sea captain, it describes an idealistic society built on a hill and protected by seven walls.

authorInfo.bio: Tommaso Campanella (1568–1639) wrote The City of the Sun. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

rightsReview.policy: US public-domain source; all listed creative contributors died by 1900. Unknown dates excluded. Edition screening, not legal certification.
